svg.text: Concurrency: nginx event-driven (thousands) vs Apache 1 thread/process
Memory: nginx low per-connection vs Apache higher per-thread
Config: nginx server/location blocks vs Apache .htaccess + VirtualHost
Best for: nginx static/proxy/LB vs Apache dynamic/legacy apps
Both support HTTPS, virtual hosting, and are production-grade choices.
• Hide backend topology from public internet
• SSL/TLS termination at the proxy layer
HAProxy algorithms: roundrobin | leastconn | source | random
nginx upstream: round_robin | ip_hash | least_conn | weight
upstream backend { least_conn; server app1:8080; server app2:8080; }
